about: What each suite id of runs.csv (wpt-scores, danbri/factoidal-builds) measures, for the Hub's Data and documents page. History is never renamed: a suite id keeps its rows, and this file says which family, specification, version, technology, test type and population each id is. Lean rows continue F* rows through 'continues'; an F* id with no Lean successor says why ('coveredBy', 'replacedBy'). Read by tests/browser-wpt/specs-data.py; how to add a suite: skills/wpt-runs section 11.

families.name: RDF
families.summary: RDF 1.1 and 1.2 syntaxes (N-Triples, N-Quads, Turtle, TriG, RDF/XML), RDF semantics, and RDF Dataset Canonicalization.

families.name: SPARQL
families.summary: SPARQL 1.1 and 1.2: query, update, result formats, protocol, federation, entailment regimes and service description.

families.name: OWL 2
families.summary: The W3C OWL 2 Test Cases as discrete populations: each test type under the Direct and the RDF-Based Semantics, profile identification, and species.
families.additiveNote: Populations overlap (a case with two test types, or both semantics, is in each), so the family shows populations, not a summed count.

families.name: SHACL

families.name: JSON-LD
